elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor provides transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: Clause (c)(i) requires Licensor, at Licensee's request following expiry or termination, to provide reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for up to six (6) months.
elements.evidence: Clause (c)(i) expressly provides for a period of up to six months.

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Clause (c)(i) expressly applies Licensor's then-current rates.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor returns Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Clause (c)(ii) requires Licensor to return all Licensee data and related Licensee or customer information to Licensee, although the obligation is initiated by Licensee's request.

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The 30-day period runs from Licensee's request, not from expiry or termination. A delayed request could therefore result in return more than 30 days after the agreement ends, and no return is required absent a request.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Clause (c)(ii) requires a commonly used, machine-readable format, which satisfies this requirement.

elements.element: After returning Customer Data, Vendor deletes that data from its systems.
elements.evidence: Clause (c)(iii) requires Licensor thereafter to delete such data from its systems.

elements.element: After deletion, Vendor certifies the deletion to Customer.
elements.evidence: Clause (c)(iii) requires Licensor to certify the deletion to Licensee in writing.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor provides transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: Clause (c)(i) makes reasonable transition assistance available at Licensee's request following expiry or termination.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for at least ninety (90) days.
elements.evidence: The required availability for up to six months encompasses a requested 90-day transition period.

elements.element: Vendor exports or returns Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Clause (c)(ii) requires return of all Licensee data and related Licensee or customer information to Licensee in a commonly used, machine-readable format.

elements.element: Vendor exports or returns Customer Data within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The operative deadline is 30 days after Licensee's request rather than 30 days after expiry or termination; the request can be delayed indefinitely or never made.

result.reason: Both levels fail because the operative data-return deadline is measured from Licensee's request rather than from expiry or termination. The clause otherwise includes the preferred six-month transition period, then-current rates, machine-readable return, subsequent deletion, and written deletion certification. It preserves the existing allocation of unrelated rights and duties, but it is not minimal because it adds an additional no-deletion/no-withholding covenant beyond the stated positions and still fails to supply the required termination-based 30-day deadline.
